links.outcome: ChatGPT-4.0 pDDI prediction compared with Micromedex checker on the same discharge prescriptions
links.effect: ChatGPT matched Micromedex for interaction occurrence (100%) but had limited accuracy for severity (37.3%) and moderate accuracy for onset (65.2%).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 accurately identified pDDIs (100 % for occurrence) but had limited accuracy for severity (37.3 %) and moderate accuracy for onset (65.2 %).

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT drug-interaction knowledge (occurrence, severity, onset) versus Micromedex reference
links.effect: Occurrence identified 100%; severity accuracy 37.3%; onset accuracy 65.2%, with limits in documentation prediction.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 accurately identified pDDIs (100 % for occurrence) but had limited accuracy for severity (37.3 %) and moderate accuracy for onset (65.2 %).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4.0's diagnostic accuracy in identifying potential drug-drug interactions compared to Micromedex on retrospective discharge prescription data, without testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
